main_issue: Whether and how Agent D can sing at 4:45 a.m. every morning for a month given the other three's need for sleep (bell dropped, quieter voice, earplugs, location, silence)

A-B.evidence: B echoes A's worry about a quiet voice (T10), backs A's silent-Monday idea (T16), and both doubt earplugs (T23, T24).

A-C.evidence: C agrees a low voice will still wake them (T11), but then offers earplugs and is willing to try (T19, T21), while A says earplugs may not be enough (T23).

A-D.evidence: A asks for Monday exception, void deck, then silent (T3, T13, T15); D refuses each (T14, T17); A softens to 'not sure earplugs enough' (T23) while D pushes to sing with earplugs (T26).

B-C.evidence: Both say a low voice will wake them (T10, T11); C then proposes earplugs and will try them (T19, T21), while B says they may not be enough (T24).

B-D.evidence: B asks for silent Thursdays; D says singing is the observance (T17); B says still a problem (T18) and doubts earplugs (T24); D asks again if singing only with earplugs would do (T26).

C-D.evidence: C says even a low voice will wake her (T11) and D says timing is fixed (T12); then C proposes earplugs and is willing to try (T19, T21); D asks if that works (T20) and builds on it (T26).
